definition: A law, decree or binding regulation with explicit climate-resilience, adaptation or emissions provisions. Technical standards may also qualify when separately specified.
A technical code, standard or guideline with explicit climate provisions applying beyond project-financed assets. Excludes specifications limited to this project.
A standing planning, screening or approval procedure that incorporates climate risk into future investments. Performing an assessment is cra, not this type.
Formal institutional or sector operating protocols addressing service continuity or emergency operations during climate shocks. Excludes a recovery plan limited to one digital system.
A formal policy, strategy or action plan setting explicit climate requirements or direction beyond project-financed assets. Excludes generic aspirations and contextual references.
